overview: This file consists only of a Department of State cover and filing-control sheet for decimal file 894.91261, concerning the public press and news-gathering agencies in relation to Japan. It records the file’s November 1942 date, administrative numbers, liaison-office routing, filing stamps dated November 20–23, 1942, and a later declassification notice; no substantive telegram, despatch, memorandum, letter, or enclosure survives in the supplied page.

subfiles.title: Department of State cover and filing-control sheet for file 894.91261
subfiles.about: Administrative cover sheet documenting the filing, routing, and later declassification of the November 1942 subject file on public press and news-gathering agencies.
subfiles.summary: The page identifies decimal file 894.91261 and bears Department of State filing and Communications and Records markings. Date stamps show liaison-office receipt or routing on November 20, processing on November 21, and confidential filing on November 23, 1942. A later notice records declassification under Executive Order 11652 or an Office of the Secretary of Defense letter dated May 3, 1972, but the supplied file contains no substantive correspondence.

interest: The page is useful chiefly as archival evidence: it preserves the Department of State’s wartime routing, classification, and records-management history for a subject file whose substantive contents are absent from the supplied scan. Its tightly clustered November 20–23, 1942 stamps may help reconstruct the file’s administrative movement, while the declassification legend documents its later release history.
